Questions

Zeotein Vegan, answered

What is Zeotein Vegan?

A five-ingredient plant protein: organic pumpkin seed protein, organic hemp protein, organic MCT oil powder, organic sea moss and a naturally occurring volcanic mineral. Each stick has 20g plant protein, 170 calories and zero added sugar.

How do I mix it?

One stick in 10 to 12 oz of water, milk or a milk alternative. Shake it in a shaker or blend it into a smoothie.

What is the volcanic mineral?

A naturally occurring mineral formed from volcanic ash, finely milled. Its full name is listed on the Supplement Facts panel printed on every pack. Questions about any ingredient? Email hello@zeotein.com.

How does the Vegan Starter Kit subscription work?

Your first order is $96.99 for 30 stick packs, with a free CleanBlend shaker. After that, 30 stick packs ship at $124.99 every 30 days, 6 weeks or 8 weeks, whichever you pick, until you cancel. Skip, pause, change the date or cancel anytime in your account.

Is it gluten-free and dairy-free?

Yes, Zeotein Vegan is gluten-free and dairy-free, and fully plant-based. There are no artificial sweeteners.

What does the 30-day guarantee cover?

Your first order of a 30-day supply, including the Vegan Starter Kit, is covered for 30 days from delivery. Email hello@zeotein.com and we'll send return instructions. Opened product is fine. The 7-day pack is not part of the guarantee. Full refund policy.

Should I check with my doctor first?

If you're pregnant, nursing, taking medication or managing a medical condition, check with your healthcare provider before starting any supplement, including this one.
